items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: people like Neal Hefty and a couple of the other trumpet players knew of him

ctx.x: Yeah, but he'd been around New York and he was building a little reputation among the younger players. And people like Neal Hefty and a couple of the other trumpet players knew of him and said that they thought he'd be fine.
